own_solution.law: Work-energy (or constant deceleration mu g): d = v^2/(2 mu g).
assumptions: constant kinetic friction mu = 0.5 with all wheels locked

defect_reasons.other: T8720/TB9A5 say the car gains a further 4.5 m/s before braking while the base says it travels at 20 m/s and brakes; 'further' makes the 24.5 m/s braking speed the intended reading, but the wording is slightly awkward.

notes: Base: 400/(2 x 0.5 x 9.8) = 40.816 m. With 24.5 m/s: 600.25/9.8 = 61.250 m. Mass cancels (friction force and inertia both proportional to m), so the mass sentences are C; T0C0C and TF039 state the same 1350 kg in different wording. Bus sentences and earlier-run sentences are D. TD024 and T4983 are numeral-free ('a further small amount').
